ExecutionerGamepass2.png|Default skin on a gamepass. }} ==Skin Trivia== *The default skin is modeled by [https://x.com/itsjsnebula Nebula].https://x.com/itsjsnebula/status/2103531565758173188 **The default skin's concept art was drawn by [https://x.com/tyronedag0at_ Tylerdagoat].https://x.com/tyronedag0at_/status/2103531258806706278 *The default skin has a cowl on Level 2 onwards, this is based on the unused initial design for the '''Executioner''', which was present on various teasers but did not end up getting added into the game.https://x.com/tyronedag0at_/status/2103780658871201938 *The Level 5 appearance of the default skin is based on [https://the-stalker-reborn-roblox.fandom.com/wiki/The_Stalker The Stalker].https://x.com/tyronedag0at_/status/2103781130969510301 *The current default skin's armor was modeled after the {{Color|Eclipse}} [[Mortar]]'s armor.https://x.com/tyronedag0at_/status/2103783702266617857 *The default skin's bun is shaped like an axe. **This was supposed to remain on all levels, however was scrapped.https://x.com/tyronedag0at_/status/2103781802351702256 *The Level 5 {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} skin armor may be inspired by [[The Umbra]]'s armor. **The [[Executioner (Lunar Overture)|Executioner]] enemy is also based on this skin. *The Default skin originally was meant to wear a cowl on every Level, though this did not make it into the game. **This appearance can still be seen on a few images officially released by the developers, though it appears to be the Level 5 appearance based on the axe it is wielding in them. *The {{Color|StarWars|Vanquisher}} skin is based on the [[w:c:starwars:Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]], most notably the [[w:c:starwars:Fifth Brother|Fifth Brother]] from ''Star Wars''. ===Roblox Catalog=== *The axe used on the Level 2 icon is the {{RLinkC|522587921|Zombie STOPing Axe}} from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== ''This only refers to cosmetic changes to the [[Executioner]]. Check the main article for statistical changes.'' *'''13 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]]g **'''Executioner''' added. *'''13 February 2022''' - [[v1.0.2]] **New skin: {{Color|Eclipse|Eclipse}} *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **Default Level 0-5 appearance changed. *'''4 May 2024''' - [[v1.20.0]]a **New skin: {{Color|Premium|Vanquisher}} *'''6 May 2024''' - [[v1.20.0|v1.20.1]] **{{Color|Premium|Vanquisher}} skin removed from [[Premium Crate]]. *'''12 February 2025''' - [[v1.53.0]] **New skin: {{Color|Lovestruck|Heartbreak}} *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **{{Bug}} {{Color|Lovestruck|Heartbreak}} skin throws the wrong weapon at later Levels instead of the one it is actually holding. *'''22 May 2026''' - [[v1.91.0]] **{{Color|StarWars|Vanquisher}} skin added to [[Daily Store#Daily Skin Store|Daily Skin Store]]. *'''21 August 2026''' - [[v2.7.0]] **Updated icons for the default, {{Color|Eclipse}} and {{Color|StarWars|Vanquisher}} skins. *'''25 September 2026''' - [[v2.12.0]] **All skins Level 0-5 appearance changed. **Upgrade icons changed. **{{Bug}} {{Color|Eclipse}} skin uses the Level 2 weapon across all Levels except Level 5. **{{Bug}} {{Color|StarWars|Vanquisher}} skin uses the Level 4 shoulder-pads and thigh-pads across all Levels. **{{Bug}} {{Color|StarWars|Vanquisher}} skin face lacks eyes. ==Notes== {{TowerNavBox}} [[Category:Gallery]]
